# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately through GitHub: open the affected repository's **Security** tab
and choose **Report a vulnerability**. Only the maintainers can see the report.

**Do not report a vulnerability in a public issue, discussion, or pull request.**

If the repository has no **Report a vulnerability** button, ask for a private
channel in the [Discord #general channel](https://discord.gg/RwzcFpN5fv) without
describing the issue there.

## Supported versions

Fixes land on the latest release of each package. Older majors get no backports.
